body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "in calendar year '26, you're already looking at a base case of close to 9 to 10 million of sales starting from there" Metric: Mexico revenue CY2026. Target: USD 9-10m. Deadline: 2026-12-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: Effectively impossible: dispatches only began in Nov-2026. Target quietly restated as 'mid-single-digit million dollar' for FY27 (Aug-26) and 'single-digit million dollar ... next 6 months' (Nov-26), without reference to the USD 9-10m CY26 base case. Timeline: Aug-24 'projects start Jan-2026' -> Nov-24 'USD 6.5m from Q4FY26' -> May-25 'Jan-26 start, absolutely on track' -> Aug-25 'warehouse operational Oct-25' -> Nov-25 'operationally ready Oct-25, in line with planned schedule' -> Feb-26 (asked by an analyst) 'waiting for customers to start placing orders ... hopefully next quarter' -> Aug-26 'on track ... first deliveries expected in Q3' -> Nov-26 'first customer dispatch this month', 'single-digit million dollar revenue this year', 1 of 3 customers live.
